notes: Fat torus (r,R)=(8,50) nm, ħ c_s=0.07 meV·µm, Δ0=0.600 meV.
g0★ = λ★ E_vac is BRIDGE algebra. Overlap g0_eff is a kernel number.
Democratic Spec(G): λ_max=(N-1)g0, λ_min=−g0 (mult N−1). Not inserted into G_ij.
CS / Berry / Skyrme truncated in the GPE.

ws_gaussian.construction: WS Gaussian × Macdonald K0 on moiré hexagon (run_tqgl_ws_G)
ws_gaussian.units: Macdonald K0 overlap (dimensionless kernel), not meV
ws_gaussian.notes: Finer-grid WS overlap. Democratic form is an OUTPUT of long-range K, not an input. g0_eff (kernel) is not identified with g0★ = λ★ E_vac.

ring_fourier.construction: hopfion_initial envelope × angular harmonics n=0..N-1, Wannier-localized on the locked torus, overlapped with Macdonald K0
ring_fourier.units: Macdonald K0 overlap (dimensionless kernel), not meV
ring_fourier.fourier_kernel_note: K0 is radial, so the angular-harmonic basis nearly diagonalises it. Coupling G uses the Wannier transform of those harmonics, then G_ii=0.
ring_fourier.notes: Computed kernel model. Circulant ring geometry has nn and nnn chords, so Spec(G) need not collapse to democratic unless K is long-range. That is a result, not a failure of the lock (the lock is algebra).
